items.title: Ride back to the office
items.context: Demo: meeting ended early; mock location is the venue; mock destination is the office; an UberX quote is $18 with pickup in 4 minutes.
items.say: You're done here early. Want me to get you an Uber back to the office? It's $18, about four minutes away.
items.confirmation: Request the $18 UberX from this venue to the office?
items.receipt: Demo only: A mock ride request was created; pickup estimate is four minutes.

items.title: Reply to Sarah
items.context: Demo: Sarah asked which time Thursday works; the mock calendar is free at 2pm. Draft: Thursday at 2pm works for me. Want to meet at the office?
items.say: Sarah asked when you can meet Thursday. Two works in the demo calendar. Want me to reply, 'Thursday at two works for me. Want to meet at the office?'

args.body: Thursday at 2pm works for me. Want to meet at the office?

items.receipt: Demo only: The mock reply to Sarah was saved.

items.title: Follow up with Zacua
items.context: Demo: an investor conversation left one follow-up open: share a Timo update. Draft: Thanks for chatting. We now have calendar-triggered calls and are testing the decision loop. Happy to send a short demo after today.
items.say: You still have that Zacua follow-up. I've drafted a short Timo update. Want to hear it before I send it?
items.confirmation: Send Zacua the update I just read?

args.subject: Timo update
args.body: Thanks for chatting. We now have calendar-triggered calls and are testing the decision loop. Happy to send a short demo after today.

items.receipt: Demo only: The mock investor follow-up was saved.

items.title: Cancel an unused trial
items.context: Demo: a fictional design-tool trial renews tomorrow for $15; fixture usage is zero this week; mock cancellation preserves access until the end of the trial.
items.say: That design-tool trial renews tomorrow for $15, and you haven't used it this week. Want me to stop the renewal?
items.confirmation: Stop this $15 renewal and keep access through the trial end?
items.receipt: Demo only: The mock renewal was stopped; access remains through the trial end.

items.title: Review an Austin flight
items.context: Demo: a fictional Austin flight quote is $142 total, departing 6pm, nonstop, one carry-on; quote is not live inventory. Exact travel date and airports are intentionally unfilled.
items.say: I found a nonstop Austin flight for $142 in the demo. Want me to save the option so you don't have to search again?
items.confirmation: Save this flight option for review, without buying it?
items.receipt: Demo only: The mock Austin flight option was saved for review. No ticket was bought.

items.title: Reply to Pri's invite
items.context: Demo: Pri invited you to a Saturday dinner; fixture calendar has no conflict; RSVP is yes for one person, with no payment or reservation.
items.say: Pri invited you to dinner Saturday, and the demo calendar is clear. Want me to tell her you're in?
items.confirmation: Accept Pri's dinner invite for just you?
items.receipt: Demo only: The mock dinner RSVP was recorded as accepted.

items.title: Prepare a meeting brief
items.context: Demo: a mock project check-in starts in 25 minutes. Three supplied notes contain the agenda, open decisions and latest status; prepare a five-bullet brief with sources.
items.say: Your project check-in is coming up. Want me to turn the notes into a short brief while you're away from your laptop?
items.confirmation: Prepare the five-bullet brief and put it on your dashboard?
items.receipt: Demo only: The mock meeting brief was added to your dashboard.

items.title: Package a review request
items.context: Demo: an agent session finished a fictional avatar-review checklist. It needs the user to choose whether to hand off the report, not approve all avatars. Draft: The review notes are ready. Please check the two remaining items before shipping.
items.say: The avatar review notes are ready. Want me to send Pri the checklist with the two open items, without saying everything is approved?
items.confirmation: Send Pri that checklist and the message I read, with the open items still marked?

args.subject: Avatar review checklist
args.body: The review notes are ready. Please check the two remaining items before shipping.

rules.name: Text vs call
rules.detail: Call for a pre-commute briefing, an urgent trigger, or a user who prefers calls; at most 2 calls a day unless urgent. Everything else is a text.

rules.name: Text rate limit
rules.detail: At most one proactive text per 60 minutes; a non-urgent reach-out inside that window holds.

rules.name: Quiet hours
rules.detail: Nothing during the user's quiet hours; an urgent trigger goes out as a text.

rules.name: Missed calls
rules.detail: After 2+ missed calls (more missed than answered), Timo stops calling unless it's urgent.

rules.name: Replies
rules.detail: A reply to the user's own text always goes by SMS.

rules.name: Own changes
rules.detail: Calendar events Timo created itself never wake the agent.

rules.name: Yes / no
rules.detail: Y, yes, yep, sure... is a yes and N, no, nope... a no; it answers only the latest pending action.

rules.name: Leave-by
rules.detail: Leave at event start minus travel minus 10 min; Timo reaches out 20 min before that. One trip per change of place; video calls, all-day events and Timo's own blocks don't count.

rules.name: Travel time
rules.detail: Fixed minutes per commute mode: BART 40, Caltrain 50, transit 40, car 30, scooter 15, bike 20, on foot 20; 30 if unknown.

rules.name: Free gaps
rules.detail: Only between 9:00 and 18:00; a gap needs 10+ usable minutes after a 3-min buffer; overlapping events merge.

rules.name: Situation filter
rules.detail: audio allows eyes-free only; phone allows eyes-free and phone; laptop allows everything.

rules.name: Fit and order
rules.detail: An item must fit the window minus 3 minutes. Sort by nearest due date, then tightest fit, then affinity; the top 5 go to the picker.

rules.name: Picker
rules.detail: The LLM picks one of those 5 and writes the text; on failure, a 3s timeout or a bad id, the #1 item with templated text.

rules.name: Reversible actions
rules.detail: A task pick proposes a calendar block and a Todoist in-progress mark; this build runs them as a dry run.

rules.name: Ask first
rules.detail: Anything that affects other people (email, invites, bookings) waits as a pending action until the user says yes.

rules.name: Voice tasks
rules.detail: A calendar gap opens a voice conversation on the first eligible task by priority; expired tasks are skipped and every task action is simulated.

rules.name: Approvals per call
rules.detail: At most 3 task approvals per call, each needing a clear yes to that task's confirmation.

rules.name: Live call gate
rules.detail: A live call needs opt-in, no quiet hours, no active call, a 1-session budget and a 300s cooldown. Off here.
